【應你心之所向 滙豐在你所在】

呢個城市嘅大小故事中，滙豐都一直與你同行。 由推動文化發展嘅宏大願景、透過數碼連繫你我生活、用心服務每個社群，以至大街小巷嘅日常所需，我哋都默默為大家實現。 逾700萬份信任，唔單止係一個數字，更代表一份長遠嘅承諾。 未來嘅旅程，滙豐會繼續與你並肩同行，一起共滙更多可能。 【If you’re looking to go further, we’re there.】 Amid the city’s hustle and bustle, HSBC has been by your side – whether in big moments or small. From championing cultural visions and connecting everyday life through digital innovation, to serving every community with care and supporting daily needs across every street and neighbourhood, we’ve been quietly making it happen. The trust of over 7 million customers isn’t just a number, it’s a long-term commitment. Together, we’ll continue to open up more opportunities in the future. #滙豐 #HSBC #應你心之所向 #滙豐在你所在 #逾700萬份信任 #共滙更多可能
